A linear trend in time

Source: R/covariates.R
trend.Rd

For use in the formula of fit_areal() and simulate_areal() only: a linear effect of time, running from -1 at the first time step to 1 at the last, so its coefficient is half the change in logit prevalence over the window. With one time step it is dropped.

Usage

trend()

Value

Not meant to be called.
